utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Ira, it’s looking good—people have been dropping off tools all morning, and we’re set for Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—thanks for the update. I’m still out running errands, but let me know if there’s anything else you need me to track down before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Ira—if you happen to spot extra extension cords or a folding table while you’re out, that’d be a big help for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal—Saturday still looks right, and the confirmed jobs are the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli—I’ve got Saturday noted with the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, and I still have the repair drive on Maple Street by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that sounds right—meet by the shed at nine, then we’ll sort tools and split up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — quick update: the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m getting the tools and volunteer list squared away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa—that sounds orderly. Once you’ve got the volunteer list set, let’s make one clear schedule for Sunday so everyone knows where to be and when.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Eli—I’ll pull the volunteer list into one clear Sunday schedule and send it around once I’ve confirmed the last few names.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far, Mara—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: As far as I know, it’s still just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, and we’re meeting by the community shed this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks—that helps a lot. I’d only been hearing scattered updates, so it’s good to know the plan’s taking shape.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway. I’ll bring gloves and a hammer; just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Bo—start with the fence behind the community garden, and we’ll sort the bench and bus stop light after that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll start on the fence and follow your lead on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Quinn, I was actually meaning to ask if we still need more volunteers for Saturday, and I can pitch in however’s useful even though I forgot my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, definitely—we can use more hands Saturday, toolbox or not, and I’m inviting everyone tonight so I’ll put you down and send you the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good—thanks, Quinn. If it helps, I can at least sort the hand tools from the spare parts once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Gus, I’ve got spare screws, tape, and gloves on the list so far—tell me what else you need for the repair drive, and I’ll check the bin.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That helps a lot, Cleo—if you’ve got zip ties and a power strip handy, add those, and I’ll bring my drill and a couple extra screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, Gus—I’ll check the bin for zip ties and a power strip and add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m ready for the repair drive, Rey—just point me to what needs fixing first, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard about a leaky faucet and a broken fence latch so far, and I’m still trying to find out which one’s first. If you want, I can check with Mara or Vik and let you know where they need you most.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works, Rey—check with Mara or Vik, and I’ll bring my toolbox Saturday at 9 so I’m ready for whichever fix comes first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Leo, I can help Saturday after school drop-off, but I need to head out again by about 2:45 for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works—come by the driveway around 10, and I’ll set you up with smaller fixes so you can wrap by 2:45.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I can be there around 10 and stay until about 2:45, so just point me to whatever smaller fixes need doing first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hana, the repair drive’s moving along nicely—we’re meeting by the community shed at nine, sorting the tools, and then splitting up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik—before I repeat that around, can you confirm whether we still only have the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, or if a third repair’s been confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: As far as I’ve heard, it’s still just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence—nothing third confirmed yet, so that’s what I’ve been telling people.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I don’t think we’re settled yet, Kira—I still need to check with Hana to confirm the headcount and who’s bringing which tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so can you check with Hana and confirm the headcount and tool list before we call the repair drive settled?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I will—I’m still waiting on Hana to confirm who’s actually coming and what tools they’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, I need the concrete numbers—how many repair requests are on the shared sheet right now, how many volunteer slots are still open, and who’s updating it before this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the exact count in front of me yet, Mina—the shared sheet’s the current list, and I’m checking with whoever last updated it so I can send you the real numbers before this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then tell me this plainly, Jules: who last updated the shared sheet, and what time are you confirming the exact request count and open volunteer slots today?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, right? I think we’ve still got the bench, the fence panel, and that bus stop light.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm who’s actually coming and what tools they’re bringing before we call the repair drive settled?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I know I’m in, and Faye said she can make it after drop-off till around pickup; for tools, Leo said bring any small appliances or tools that need fixing, but I’d check with Leo or Opal for the full list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it—I just got here, so point me where I’m needed and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good timing—take the folding table by the shed and help Gus sort the small appliances into fixable and parts-only piles.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll head to the folding table now and help Gus sort through the small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking that too, Oren—last I can confirm it’s just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, so I don’t want to guess on volunteer numbers until Jules confirms whether there’s a third repair.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks, Hana; I don’t know the count offhand, so maybe I can go sort the boxes by the folding table while Jules checks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds helpful, Oren—thank you. If Jules confirms there’s still only those two repairs, we can figure out whether we need more volunteers from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Rey, the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center on Maple Street by the community garden, and I’m still firming up the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa—I’d only heard about a couple small fixes so far, so do you know what the first priority repair is?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Not yet—I’m still pulling together the repair list, so right now I’m just collecting fixes and matching them with the tools and volunteers we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces so far, Eli—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Latest I’ve heard, tools are already coming in, so I’d like us to start with one shared list at the shed and set clear times for who’s covering what.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds more organized than what I’d heard—if you all get that list up at the shed, I can keep an eye out for updates second-hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still on for Saturday at 9 with my toolbox, Opal—if there’s anything specific you want me to start on, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—I’ve got you down for Saturday at 9 with your toolbox, and the first thing to start on is the loose fence panel behind the community garden on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Opal—I’ll start with the loose fence panel behind the community garden on Maple Street when I get there Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we’re still doing the repair drive by the community shed, but I’m waiting on Hana or Jules to lock down the time and who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Alright, I’m still out running errands, but keep me posted once Hana or Jules lock down the time and tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, sorry—I’ll let you know as soon as Hana or Jules confirm the time and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Faye, it’s coming together nicely—Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and folks have been dropping off tools all morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update — I can help after drop-off, but I need to be free again for pickup between 2:45 and 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s perfect, Faye—I’ll note you down to help after drop-off and make sure you’re free again by 2:45 for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So that’s two confirmed volunteers—Sam and Uli—and you’re personally covering the tool drop-off spot at the lot, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got the tool drop-off covered, and I’ll put Sam and Uli plus the logged repair requests into one shared list today so we can match them up cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—once you update that shared list today, how many repair requests are actually logged right now, and which ones still don’t have volunteer coverage?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara — it’s looking promising for next Saturday at the community center lot; I’m just waiting on the final okay this afternoon before I send everyone the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules—keep me posted, and once you get the final okay I’ll help spread the word about the time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — that’d help a lot, and I’ll send you the exact time as soon as I get the okay this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad it’s moving, but I still want the headcount confirmed and the shared tool list sorted at the shed first so Saturday doesn’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ve been telling everyone the repair drive’s moving along nicely, and I’ll keep repeating that we need the headcount confirmed and the tool list sorted at the shed first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik—that’s exactly what I needed to hear; once those are confirmed, I’ll feel much better about Saturday staying manageable.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning, Cleo—thanks for checking in. We’re meeting by the community shed at nine, and I’m still only counting the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence until Saturday’s fully confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ve got screws, tape, and some gloves on hand, so tell me if the roof patch or Mrs. Alvarez’s fence needs anything specific and I’ll check the bins.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo—that helps a lot. For now, screws and gloves will definitely get used, and I’ll let you know if we need anything more once Saturday’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help spread the word once you and Hana lock down the time—I’m still a little fuzzy on who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah—I’m still waiting on the final confirmation this afternoon, and once Hana and I have the time and location nailed down, I’ll send you the details, including who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, thanks—I’ll hold off till you and Hana confirm, then I can help spread the word once I know the time and what folks are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Bo, it’s really coming together—Saturday at 10 in Leo’s driveway, and folks have been dropping off tools all morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, sounds set then—what still needs fixing, and do I need to bring anything besides the gloves and hammer?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Bo, gloves and that hammer are perfect, and if you’ve got a spare extension cord, bring it along—I’m still sorting the final fix-it list, but it’s mostly small appliance and bike repairs so far.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds fine, Dane, but can you confirm who’s actually coming and what tools each person is bringing before we call it settled?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Kira—I’m still checking in with everyone, but Jules, Vik, and Leo are helping coordinate, and I’ll confirm who’s bringing what before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but are Jules, Vik, and Leo definitely coming, and can you confirm the full headcount and tool list before we call the repair drive settled?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’d only heard bits and pieces, so that helps—a Saturday 9 o’clock start at the lot sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad that cleared it up, Nell—I’m still bringing my drill and extra screwdrivers, and I’ll let you know if Rosa finalizes anything else for the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus—that helps a lot; I’ve only been getting second-hand updates, so let me know if Rosa adds anything else folks should bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s moving fast—Saturday’s repair drive is turning into a real block effort, and I’m inviting everyone tonight, so I can loop you in too if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Quinn—that helps a lot. The plan is still to meet by the community shed at nine, sort the tools, and then split up, so please pass that along when you invite folks tonight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll spread that around tonight: community shed at nine, tools first, then we split up, and I’ll keep pulling more folks in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but can you tell me how many volunteers are actually confirmed and whether anyone locked in the tool drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus says Sam and Uli are confirmed, and he’s covering the tool drop-off at the lot with his drill and spare screwdrivers; do you know who’s updating the shared list and whether Jules confirmed that third repair yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That helps a lot—thanks. I’m still out running errands, and I don’t know yet who’s updating the shared list or whether Jules confirmed that third repair, so keep me posted if you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa, as far as I know we’re still meeting by the community shed this weekend, and it’s just the roof patch plus Mrs. Alvarez’s fence so far.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got it as Sunday at the community center on Maple Street by the garden, and I’ll update the location note. I’m still firming up the tool list, so send any other fixes my way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, Rosa, it’s the community shed this weekend, not the community center on Maple—I still only have the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 10 in my driveway still works—come by a little early if you can, and bring any small appliances or tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I can come a little early. Do you know what the first priority is once we get started?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with tool sorting at 9 by the community shed, then we’ll set up in my driveway and take small appliance fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m all set for Saturday at 9 with my toolbox, Eli—just point me to the small fixes or the donated tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Sam—be at the shed at 9, and we’ll start with the shared list so I can point you to the small fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli—I’ll be at the shed at 9 with my toolbox and ready to start on the small fixes from the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—I’m still nervous about Saturday until we’ve confirmed the headcount and who’s bringing which tools, but your shared list should make it easier to keep things manageable.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—I’ve got Saturday at 10 on Maple Street by the community garden noted, and I’ll keep the shared list updated with headcount and tool assignments so it’s all clear before then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That does help, thanks—I’ll feel a lot better once the headcount’s filled in and we can see tool assignments in one place before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we spread anything, can we confirm whether it’s still just the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, or if a third repair’s actually been confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I only know for sure about the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, so I’d wait to mention a third repair until Rosa confirms the final list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That matches what I’ve heard too, so let’s stick to those two and wait for Rosa before we say anything more.
